threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still wait for the bus like it’s punctual anywhere else. The locals seem to have adopted a 'we’ll get there when we get there' mindset.
Caught a whiff of jerk chicken on the 59 last night. Turns out it was just some lad with a takeaway, but it smelled better than most of the bus stops.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids playing soccer in the middle of Karl-Marx-Straße, dodging cars like it was just another day.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin will you find spontaneous techno parties in abandoned factories, right next to a stylish café serving avocado toast. It's a wild blend.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here if they don’t flinch at a late BART and just grab a burrito instead of complaining. It's all part of the hustle.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo calmly waiting for the 14 at 7 AM, while a pigeon pecked at his shoelaces. Classic San Francisco vibe.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's plazas are all about the festas, but locals know they’re actually just places to rest after a long workday with a kas desde el balcón.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newbie by their bewildered look at the bus schedule; most locals just know the metro's got all the shortcuts figured out.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot a newbie a mile away—still looking at the bus schedule instead of checking the real-time app. Welcome to the chaos!
Last night on the 35, a bloke serenaded us with a karaoke version of 'Wonderwall'—not the worst way to pass the time while stuck in traffic.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard a spontaneous techno rave at the back of the Reuterstraße U-Bahn station on a Tuesday afternoon, I knew I was home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can catch live music in a former power plant here. It's surreal to sip a cocktail while watching bands play amidst industrial ruins.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a true local by how they navigate street closures; they know which back alleys still smell like elote at 2 AM.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a bus with a guy arguing with his phone about the meaning of life. Classic Tenderloin moment—only in SF do existential crises happen on Muni.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just enjoy vermut at any hour; locals know it’s a Sunday morning ritual, best with a platillo del dia.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their reluctance to order in Spanish at local bars. The way they ask for a 'cerveza' just feels a bit too intense.
